checkedAlternates.risk: Promise has static methods like Promise.all.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Promise is an instantiable async constructor (group-1), whereas Math, JSON, Reflect, and Intl cannot be constructed with new (group-4).
Symbol and BigInt are callable primitive constructors (group-2).
